question: How can the completed DuPage target screen and proposed experimental distinctions be communicated without converting RNA estimates into functional claims?
decision: Publish reproducible portfolio figures with complete candidate coverage, explicit post-outcome focused selection, sensitivity ranges and qualitative experimental alternatives.
strongest_rival: Selective display, ambiguous effect units and diagrams that look causal could overstate the exploratory RNA evidence.
discriminator: Show all 32 coding-frontier genes, annotation exclusions, explicitly focused candidates and a labelled proposal matrix; keep source-value tables and figure captions.
exposure_record: All plotted values, annotations and candidate literature are exposed; figures summarize completed v1/v2 screens and do not provide validation.
biological_unit: Source biological preparation; individual mouse, pool membership and cross-state pairing remain unknown. This stage counts files/features, not animals.
nesting_and_overlap: Twelve libraries from one study; GSM1423627 excluded by authors. All reuse of these libraries is shared-source reanalysis. Replicate labels do not prove pairing or independence.
population_and_selection: Female C57BL/6 healthy mosaic mice; spleen/LN sorted Foxp3-positive CD4+CD25+YFP+RFP+ Tregs, conditional Ezh2 HET or KO, observed CD62L high/low.
contrast: (mean log2(FPKM+1) KO_low - HET_low) - (KO_high - HET_high); observed states, not a temporal intervention.
endpoint: Annotation counts, preserved RNA contrasts and sensitivity ranges, and a qualitative comparison matrix.
methods: No expression refit. Figure 1 annotation/frontier and overlapping-track counts; figure 2 all 32 protein-frontier genes alphabetically with high/low/interaction values; figure 3 ten declared post-outcome genes with 14-configuration extrema; figure 4 proposed comparisons only. Save PNG at 300 dpi plus PDF/SVG, exact source-value TSV and manifest.
missingness_and_exclusions: All 32 coding-frontier genes shown; focused display explicitly adds prior anchors Areg, Il2ra, Pde3b and Bcl2. No candidate becomes significant or a validated target from display.
multiplicity: No tests. Focused genes selected after observing outcomes and literature; full frontier remains visible.
precision_basis: Observed sample variation and PCA only; no confidence intervals because mouse/pool identity and independence are not qualified.
interpretation_limit: Post-outcome exploratory RNA selection from surviving Foxp3-positive preparations. Sensitivity stability cannot establish biological independence, direct Ezh2 regulation, protein expression, cell function, novelty or target validity.
stop_rule: Stop on missing genes, hash mismatch, nonfinite numeric values or incorrect source values. Inspect rendered figures before portfolio delivery; layout corrections require new versioned code/output.
amendment_reason: Owner requested figures stored in the repository as a portfolio. Rendering completed data and explicit proposals; no numerical screen is replaced.
